verses.1: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”
verses.2: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!
verses.3: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,
verses.4: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.
verses.5: For there are set thrones for judgement, the thrones of David’s house.
verses.6: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.
verses.7: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.
verses.8: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”
verses.9: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.
